notes.title: Release of KUBEON version 0.9.0
notes.notes: [h1]Release of KUBEON version 0.9.0[/h1][p][/p][p]The 0.9.0 version of Kubeon brings the following changes:[/p][list][*][p]Modification of the level unlocking conditions (based on a minimum number of required stars) and addition of a total star counter on the level selection screen,[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustment of the sound effects volume in the menu,[/p][/*][*][p]Update of an enemy in level 5.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674910/3675501808c5829d50fdc3818936280228be279e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Feel free to share your feedback and stay updated on [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@game_dev_stories"]TikTok[/url], [url="https://x.com/siber_w"]X[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/gamedev_story/"]Instagram[/url] or [url="https://discord.com/invite/xAP6Gn2bhD"]Discord[/url].[/p][p]See you soon for the next steps <3[/p]

notes.title: Minor bugs fix and Steamdeck compatibility
notes.notes: [p]Many thanks to everyone. After the release of the Kubeon's demo, players pointed out some bad input behaviours. Everythings has been fixed and the [b]Steamdeck compatibility[/b] has been checked (thanks to some people on Reddit).[/p][p][/p][p]Here is the full patch note : [/p][p][/p][h1]Kubeon 0.8.3[/h1][list][*][p]D-PAD inputs has been added to the game[/p][/*][*][p]A and B buttons has been reversed to meet the largest number of controllers (every PS and XBOX controllers basically)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]See you later for a futur update ! <3[/p]

notes.title: BIG NEWS! Playable demo release :-)
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone :)[/p][p]I’m happy to announce that the Kubeon demo is now live. The first two levels of the game are playable (the yellow and the green). I hope you enjoy discovering the game's atmosphere. If the visual effects are too intense, you can disable them in the settings.[/p][p]Are you ready to try it out? The goal is simple: survive.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="37o67PpET-A;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]I hope you enjoy this playable demo while waiting for the final game release.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674910/c12a0c9c3eeffa34f543e2d8df1eef889e7a24aa.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Remember, this is a demo of a game still in development. That means you might encounter a few bugs (hopefully as few as possible).[/p][p][/p][p]Feel free to share your feedback and stay updated on [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@game_dev_stories"]TikTok[/url], [url="https://x.com/siber_w"]X[/url], [url="https://www.instagram.com/gamedev_story/"]Instagram[/url], or [url="https://discord.com/invite/xAP6Gn2bhD"]Discord[/url].[/p][p]See you soon for the next steps <3[/p]
